title: Silver after an AUD/JPY carry crash day

rule.signal: AUD/JPY daily return beyond 1.5 x the sd of the 20 returns before the day (crash = down, rally = up)
rule.costs: $0.05 a round trip; no financing (no silver rate in council/fills.mjs); descriptive sensitivity at gold's rate 0.000148 of price a night
rule.baseline: same-side trade after every eligible day of the same calendar year

tests.what: carry crash (AUD/JPY down > 1.5 sd): buy silver, hold 5 days (primary)
carry rally (AUD/JPY up > 1.5 sd): sell silver, hold 5 days
carry crash (AUD/JPY down > 1.5 sd): buy silver, hold 10 days
